extracted.intended_audience: applicants, representatives, and receiving offices filing patents, utility models or industrial designs under the ARIPO Harare Protocol
extracted.subtask_description: Filling and submitting ARIPO Harare Protocol forms and complying with the Protocol's procedural, formal and documentary requirements for patent, utility model and industrial design applications and related actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for alteration/correction/voluntary amendment (Form No.1) — identification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearly identify the matter to be altered or corrected (entry in Patents Register / Utility Model Register / Industrial Designs Register) and indicate the alteration/correction either as shown in red ink on an annexed copy or described in the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify which register the alteration relates to and provide the exact corrected text or mark-up; type name(s) under signature(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for alteration/correction — appointment of new agent (Form No.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: If appointing a NEW agent/representative to be recorded, clearly identify the agent by name and address and indicate that they are to be recorded in the relevant register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide agent's name and address and include signature(s) and date; indicate capacity of person requesting (e.g., applicant, representative).

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary amendment of specification (Form No.1) — authority and specification
rubrics_metrics.description: For voluntary amendment of the specification (description, claims, drawing, etc.) the request must specify the amendment and reference Section 3(10)(g) of the Harare Protocol and Administrative Instructions 27(1) & (2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the exact amendment(s) and include any required annexes showing red-ink changes; ensure signatures and dates are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for copies of extracts (Form No.2) — permission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule 3 requires the written permission of the applicant, or the person who withdrew an application, in order to obtain copies of extracts from the files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clearly which extract(s) are requested and supply the written permission of the applicant/person who withdrew the application; provide number of copies requested and identify the register and application numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for grant of patent/registration of utility model — mandatory applicant and filing data (Form No.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: The request must include the title of invention, applicant(s) data (name, address, nationality, country of residence/principal place of business, contact details), inventor information, and designation of States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If space is insufficient use the supplemental box; ensure all applicant and inventor fields are completed and that any statement specifying the basis of the applicant’s right accompanies the form if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative/power of attorney requirement (Form No.3 & Form No.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a representative is appointed the power of attorney (ARIPO Form No.4) must accompany the request or be filed within two months from filing of the request. The GPA reference number may be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a separate power of attorney is filed, indicate this on the request; Form No.4 must be signed by the appointing person and must indicate which matter(s) the representative will act on.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority document and translation timing (Form No.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: If priority is claimed, the certified copy of the earlier application should accompany the Form or be furnished within 3 months; the English translation of the earlier application should accompany the Form or be furnished within 6 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide DAS reference if applicable; indicate multiple earlier applications in supplemental box; check relevant boxes to show timing of documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure at official exhibition exception (Form No.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure occurred at an official or officially recognized exhibition not more than six months before filing or priority date may be disregarded for prior art purposes if indicated and accompanied by a statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the appropriate box and include the accompanying statement where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for substantive examination — timing and fees (Form No.3 & Form No.13A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A request for substantive examination and applicable fees (Rule 18(1)(a)) may accompany the application or be furnished within 3 years from filing date; the request is not deemed filed until substantive examination fees (including additional and claims fees if any) have been paid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ARIPO Form No.13A to request substantive examination, list fee items, and ensure payment is made; note the application of Rule 18(1)(a) and Instruction 48(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application checklist — contents and accompanying documents (Form No.3 checklist)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application must state the number of sheets for request, description, claims, abstract and be accompanied by required items such as signed power of attorney, statement of basis of applicant’s right, priority documents, PCT documents, English translations, receipt for fees, undertaking to pay prescribed fees within 21 days, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the checklist to confirm completeness; include any 'other documents' as specified; suggest a figure number of drawings for the abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment of representative — scope and revocation (Form No.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: The appointment must identify the representative, specify the proceedings they may act in (patent, utility model, industrial design, other), ratify acts done by the representative, request that notices be sent to the representative, and revoke any previous appointment in respect of the same matter(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form must be signed by the person appointing the representative and include typed name(s) under signature(s); provide contact details of representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request by Contracting State for remittance of fees (Form No.5) — identification and payment mode
rubrics_metrics.description: The requesting office must indicate where fees held by ARIPO in favour of a contracting State should be remitted, identify the office/address and indicate mode of payment and include signature and title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full payee details and specify payment instructions; type name and title under signature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of non-compliance with fee/designation fee (Form No.6) — transmission hold
rubrics_metrics.description: If the requirements of Rule 11 with respect to prescribed fees have not been fulfilled, the receiving office shall notify the applicant and inform that, pursuant to Instruction 31(1), the application will not be transmitted to the ARIPO Office until requirements are fulfilled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State which application type is affected and reasons for non-fulfillment; include signature and office identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation to correct application by receiving office (Form No.7) — content and time limit
rubrics_metrics.description: After examination pursuant to Rule 13, if the application on its face does not fulfill requirements of Rule 5(1)(a),(b),(c) or Instruction 26(1), the receiving office requests the applicant within 2 months to file the specified correction together with payment of the prescribed fee or to request transmission to ARIPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify which part fails (request, description, claims) and list corrections required; indicate the application number and date of receipt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement of receipt by receiving office (Form No.8) — confirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The receiving office must acknowledge receipt of the application and state the date of receipt in the acknowledgement sent to applicant/representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide title of invention/industrial design and applicant details; include signature and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal by receiving office to ARIPO (Form No.9) — verification and number of copies
rubrics_metrics.description: When transmitting documents to ARIPO the receiving office must indicate number of copies, whether it has verified that the application on the face of it fulfilled Rule 5(1)(a),(b),(c), whether fees/undertaking verified, stamp and number documents and attach acknowledgement of receipt issued to applicant’s representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If application does not fulfil requirements but applicant requested transmission nonetheless, state this; mark documents with date of receipt and official stamp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of transmittal to applicant (Form No.10) — filing requirements after transmittal
rubrics_metrics.description: The receiving office must notify the applicant that the documents making up the application have been transmitted to ARIPO and advise that further documents shall be filed directly with ARIPO in 3 copies (priority earlier application and translation in 1 copy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include application numbers, dates, and representatives' details; signature and office identification required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation by ARIPO to correct application (Form No.11) — formal requirements and filing date consequence
rubrics_metrics.description: After examination pursuant to Rules 14/15 and related Instructions, ARIPO may find the application on the face of it does not fulfil Rule 5(1)(a),(b),(c) requirements or prescribed formal requirements and request corrections within 2 months together with payment of prescribed fee. The application shall not be accorded a filing date until said requirements are fulfilled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify which element fails (request, description, claims, abstract) and provide correction instructions; for missing abstract, applicant may file abstract within 2 months or pay ARIPO to prepare it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of filing date (Form No.12) — filing date communication
rubrics_metrics.description: ARIPO shall notify applicant/representative and designated States of the date accorded as the filing date pursuant to Rule 14(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote ARIPO application number in all subsequent communications; list all recipients of the notification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of compliance with formal requirements (Form No.13)
rubrics_metrics.description: ARIPO shall notify that the application complies with the prescribed formal requirements pursuant to Instruction 41 and send the notification to industrial property offices of each designated State and to the applicant’s representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include application number and filing date; type name of Director General under signature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for substantive examination form specifics (Form No.13A) — fee prerequisite
rubrics_metrics.description: A Request for Substantive Examination must be made on Form No.13A in accordance with Section 3(3) and Rule 18(1)(a); the request is not deemed filed until the substantive examination fee (including any additional fee and claims fee) has been paid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide application number, filing date, applicant details and list fee items; include signature and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision refusing application for non-compliance with formal requirements (Form No.14) — reconsideration and national route
rubrics_metrics.description: If ARIPO decides to refuse an application for non-compliance with formal requirements or time limits, the applicant may request reconsideration on ARIPO Form No.15 within 2 months from the notification date; notwithstanding reconsideration, the applicant may within 3 months request on ARIPO Form No.23 that the application be treated as a national application in any designated State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notification must state reasons and to whom it is being sent (representative, receiving office and industrial property offices of designated States); include Director General signature and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees/undertakings — verification and receipts
rubrics_metrics.description: Receiving and ARIPO Offices must verify submission or payment of prescribed fees and issue receipts; undertaking to pay prescribed fees within 21 days may be accepted as accompanying the form where indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If fees are unpaid, receiving office must notify applicant and may withhold transmission; ensure receipts and fee evidence accompany filings as required.
